facts.says: Google Play genre EDUCATION; title Endless Reader; summary: Kids will have a blast learning sight words with the adorable Endless monsters.
BeBook is a trademark of Endless Ideas, a Dutch manufacturer of e-book readers and tablet computers. The first BeBook device was a rebranding of the Hanlin eReader.

judges.reason: The app is an educational game where kids learn sight words through play.
The app is classified as education under productivity because it is an educational tool designed to help kids learn sight words.
